messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout for project-sunset. Window: 2024-11-02 02:00 UTC. Quiet/freeze from 2024-11-01 18:00 -> 2024-11-02 06:00 UTC. Plan: canary 10% (30m) -> 50% (30m) -> 100%. Pin: sunset-v3.2. Please ACK and confirm any exemptions or last-minute blockers.

alex: ACK. On-call and will monitor latency + error-rate dashboards.

jin: Reconfiguring autoscaler to avoid scale-flapping during steady-state. Will set `autoscale.enabled=false` for the window and push a changelist.

sophia: QA smoke jobs queued. I'll run the golden prompt suite at +15m after canary starts. If top-1 accuracy delta > 2% we abort and call rollback.

tara: Confirmed on release coordination. Locking PRs #4521 and #4567. Release notes draft at https://docs.internal/release/4521 — please review. Rollback playbook excerpt below.

```bash
# rollback to previous stable
rictl pin set project-sunset model=sunset-v3.1
rictl rollout abort --release project-sunset
# emergency quickscale if pods stuck:
rictl scale set project-sunset replicas=0
rictl scale set project-sunset replicas=3
```

oscar: Small note from staging: embeddings latency spikes for seq > 1024 observed in canary. I'll add a temporary throttling rule on the canary route: `max_tokens=1024` for first 10m.

infra-bot: Canary patch deployed to canary pool at 02:00 UTC (deploy-id: dpl-1738123456). Alerts wired to #incidents and #eng-oncall.

alex: One operational ask — do not change quantization profile during the window. Keep quantization=aq8 across both canary and control groups.

sophia: Noted. Also configuring an automatic rollback trigger: if canary error-rate > 2% for 5m OR p50 latency regresses > 30% for 5m -> trigger abort.

tara: Final go/no-go at 01:50 UTC in this thread. If no objections by then we proceed. @jin please confirm autoscale change applied by 01:40.

jin: Done — autoscale disabled in staging and prod at 01:37 UTC. I'll re-enable after 04:00 UTC unless we call rollback earlier.

deploy-bot: Rollout started at 2024-11-02 02:00 UTC. Live logs: https://logs.internal/r/1738123456 . This thread will be archived after the window closes. :party_parrot:
